# ymcp reference

<!-- Generated by TestReference in cmd/ymcp/reference_test.go; don't edit by hand. -->

ymcp has four external interfaces, each described here from the code that defines it:

- [the command line](#command-line);
- [the MCP server](#mcp-server): its tools and prompts, over stdio or Streamable HTTP;
- [the pipeline tools](#pipeline-tools) a pipeline's agent gets;
- [the pipeline file](#pipeline-file) that configures a pipeline.

The [README](../README.md) explains how they fit together.

## Command line

Every command reads its profiles from the configuration file (see [Configuration](../README.md#configuration)) and
takes `--profile <key>` (or `YMCP_PROFILE`). Output goes to standard output; an error goes to
standard error, and the command exits with status 1.

```text
ymcp — YouTrack MCP server

Usage:
  ymcp [global flags] [command] [arguments]

Commands:
  serve     Run the MCP server (default). Flags: --transport stdio|http, --addr, --token, --profiles, --tools, --confirm
  auth      Set or replace the URL, login and password of a profile
  setup     Profiles in a TUI: sign-in, allowed tools, confirmations, MCP clients; flags for scripts
  check     Log in and print the current user
  call      Call one tool: ymcp call <tool> ['{"json":"args"}']
  logs      Show the server log; -f follows it, -n N sets the lines, --path prints where it is
  health    Check that a running HTTP server answers; --url, default http://127.0.0.1:8090
  pipeline  Agent pipelines that work on YouTrack issues: ymcp pipeline help
  update    Update ymcp to the latest release
  version   Print the version

Global flags:
  --profile KEY  Use this YouTrack profile (YMCP_PROFILE also works); see setup
  --env FILE     Load YOUTRACK_* variables from a dotenv file
  -v             Debug logging, including every YouTrack request (YMCP_LOG_LEVEL also works)
  --version      Print the version, like the version command
```

```text
ymcp pipeline — agents that work on YouTrack issues

Usage:
  ymcp pipeline                             Open the TUI: profiles, pipelines, boards, run cards, the inbox
  ymcp pipeline list                        List pipelines, their runner and active runs
  ymcp pipeline new NAME --profile P --dir D --query Q
                                            Create a pipeline with defaults; also --agent claude|kimi|opencode|acp,
                                            --command CMD (acp), --preset NAME, --host SSH_ALIAS
  ymcp pipeline presets                     List the prompt presets, built-in and your own
  ymcp pipeline presets show NAME           Print a preset as JSON
  ymcp pipeline presets copy FROM TO        Copy a preset, built-in or yours, to a new one of yours
  ymcp pipeline presets edit NAME           Edit one of your presets in $VISUAL or $EDITOR
  ymcp pipeline presets rename OLD NEW      Rename one of your presets
  ymcp pipeline presets rm NAME [-y]        Delete one of your presets
  ymcp pipeline presets save NAME --from PIPELINE [--rationale TEXT]
                                            Save a pipeline's prompts as a preset of yours
  ymcp pipeline notify [test | set K=V...]  Show, test or change notifications
  ymcp pipeline NAME run [-d]               Run the pipeline in the foreground (ctrl+c stops it), or with -d
                                            in the background
  ymcp pipeline NAME stop [--force]         Stop the background runner; --force kills it
  ymcp pipeline NAME check                  Check the profile, query, stages, git and agent
  ymcp pipeline NAME status                 Runner and active runs
  ymcp pipeline NAME runs [--all]           Runs; --all includes finished ones
  ymcp pipeline NAME logs [RUN] [-f] [-n N] The event feed of a run, or the log of the runner without RUN
  ymcp pipeline NAME answer RUN TEXT        Answer a run that waits for input, or give it feedback
  ymcp pipeline NAME cancel RUN             Cancel a run
  ymcp pipeline NAME delete RUN [-y]        Delete a run that has ended from the local store
  ymcp pipeline NAME show                   Print the pipeline JSON
  ymcp pipeline NAME edit                   Edit the JSON in $VISUAL or $EDITOR
  ymcp pipeline NAME rm [-y]                Delete the pipeline
  ymcp pipeline NAME rename NEW             Rename the pipeline
  ymcp pipeline NAME copy NEW               Copy the pipeline
```

```text
ymcp pipeline notify — how pipelines reach you

Usage:
  ymcp pipeline notify                   Providers, whether they are on, their events and whether they work here
  ymcp pipeline notify test [--provider P]
                                         Send a test notification through the enabled providers
  ymcp pipeline notify set KEY=VALUE...  Change settings: toast.enabled=false, toast.events=needs_input,run_failed,
                                         toast.sound=false; an empty value (toast.events=) restores the default

Events: needs_input, run_failed, review_ready, run_done, runner_stopped (default: needs_input, run_failed).
A pipeline can narrow these with "notifications": {"providers": [...], "events": [...]} in its JSON.
```

## MCP server

`ymcp serve` speaks the Model Context Protocol over stdio, or Streamable HTTP with `--transport http`
(see [HTTP](../README.md#http)). It offers the tools and prompts below; a profile may serve only some groups of them
(see [Choosing tools](../README.md#choosing-tools)).

**Output.** A tool answers with one text content: indented JSON for data, short text for a confirmation. Attachments
may come as images or resources. A failure is a result with `isError: true` and a message that says what
went wrong and what to do: the allowed values, the tool that finds the right ID, or the permission that is missing.
Custom fields go in and come out by their display names.

**Confirmation.** With confirmations on (a profile's default; `serve --confirm off` turns them off), every tool
marked destructive below takes one more optional argument, `confirm` (string). `apply_command` asks only for
commands that remove something, `call_api` only for DELETE. Called without `confirm`, the tool changes
nothing and answers `{"confirmationRequired": true, "operationId", "operation", "confirm", "expiresAt", "message"}`;
the model asks the user, and if they agree calls again with the same arguments and `confirm` set to that
secret. A secret works once, for those arguments, for 10 minutes.

### Issues: search, read, create, edit, link, commands, history

#### `search_issues`

*Search issues* · read-only

Searches issues with the YouTrack query language and returns id, summary, project, resolved, reporter, created, updated and the requested custom fields. Use get_issue for full details. Paginated. YouTrack search query. Syntax: - free text matches summary, description and comments; wildcards * and ? - attribute filters: project: DEMO, for: me, reporter: jdoe, tag: {multi word}, <Field>: <Value> (e.g. State: Open, Priority: Critical) - negation with -: State: -Fixed; multi-word names and values in braces: {Fix versions}: {2026.1 EAP} - dates: created: {This month}, updated: {minus 2h} .. *, created: 2026-01-01 .. 2026-02-01 - shortcuts: #Unresolved, #Resolved, has: attachments, has: -comments - links: <link type>: DEMO-1 (e.g. subtask of: DEMO-1), links: DEMO-1, mentions: DEMO-1 - terms are joined with AND by space; use "or" and parentheses for alternatives - sort: sort by: updated desc

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | YouTrack search query, see the tool description for syntax |
| `customFieldsToReturn` | null or array of string | no | Custom fields to include in results. Default: Type, State, Assignee. Pass [] for none. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max issues to return. Default 20, max 20. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of issues to skip. Default 0. |

#### `count_issues`

*Count issues* · read-only

Counts issues matching a YouTrack search query without fetching them.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | YouTrack search query, same syntax as search_issues |

#### `get_issue`

*Get issue* · read-only

Returns full details of an issue: summary, description, URL, project, reporter, tags, votes, custom fields, links, attachments and the most recent comments.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123, or draft ID, e.g. 3-22 |
| `recentCommentsCount` | null or integer | no | How many latest comments to include. Default 5. |

#### `get_issue_fields_schema`

*Get issue fields schema* · read-only

Returns a JSON Schema of the project's custom fields with allowed values. Must be used before create_issue and update_issue: property names are the exact field names to pass.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `projectKey` | string | yes | Project key, e.g. DEMO |

#### `create_issue`

*Create issue* · changes data

Creates an issue. Call get_issue_fields_schema first: projects may require fields on creation. If the project is not known, ask the user. Returns the issue ID and URL.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | yes | Project key, e.g. DEMO. Ask the user if unknown. |
| `summary` | string | yes | Issue summary (title) |
| `customFields` | object | no | Custom field values keyed by exact field name from get_issue_fields_schema, e.g. {"Type":"Task","Priority":"Minor"}. Multi-value fields take arrays. |
| `description` | string | no | Issue description, plain text or Markdown |
| `parentIssue` | string | no | ID of the parent issue; the new issue becomes its subtask |
| `permittedGroups` | null or array of string | no | Limit visibility to these group names |
| `permittedUsers` | null or array of string | no | Limit visibility to these user logins |

#### `create_draft_issue`

*Create draft issue* · changes data

Creates an issue draft visible only to the current user. Fill it in with update_issue using the returned draft ID. Returns the draft ID (e.g. 3-22) and URL.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | yes | Project key, e.g. DEMO |
| `summary` | string | yes | Draft summary |

#### `update_issue`

*Update issue* · changes data, idempotent

Updates an issue: summary, description, a subset of custom fields, star (subscription) and vote. Only the given properties change; to change part of the description, use edit_issue_description. Returns the issue ID and what was changed.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123, or draft ID, e.g. 3-22 |
| `customFields` | object | no | Custom fields to change, keyed by exact field name from get_issue_fields_schema. null clears a field. |
| `description` | null or string | no | New description, plain text or Markdown |
| `subscription` | null or boolean | no | true stars the issue for the current user, false unstars it |
| `summary` | null or string | no | New summary |
| `vote` | null or boolean | no | true votes for the issue, false removes the vote |

#### `edit_issue_description`

*Edit issue description* · changes data

Changes part of an issue's description by exact find-and-replace, without resending the whole text. Read the issue first and copy oldText from it, or set regexp to match a pattern. All edits apply or none do. Returns the issue ID, URL and number of replacements.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edits` | null or array of object | yes | Replacements applied in order, each to the result of the previous one |
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123, or draft ID, e.g. 3-22 |

#### `change_issue_assignee`

*Change issue assignee* · changes data, idempotent

Sets the Assignee of an issue. Pass null to unassign.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assigneeLogin` | null or string | yes | Login of the new assignee, or null to unassign |
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |

#### `delete_issue`

*Delete issue* · destructive, idempotent

Permanently deletes an issue or a draft, with its comments, attachments and work items. This cannot be undone; confirm with the user first.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123, or draft ID, e.g. 3-22 |

#### `apply_command`

*Apply command* · destructive

Applies a YouTrack command to one or more issues, the same as the command dialog in the UI: set fields, assign, tag, move to another project, add links, vote, star and more in one line. The command is validated first and nothing is applied if any part is invalid; dryRun only validates and lists suggestions.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | string | yes | Command as typed in the YouTrack command dialog, e.g. State In Progress, for jdoe, tag backend, Priority Critical, project OPS, remove tag backend |
| `comment` | string | no | Comment to add together with the command |
| `dryRun` | boolean | no | Only parse the command and report what it would do or why it is invalid. Default false. |
| `issueIds` | null or array of string | no | Issues to apply the command to, e.g. ["DEMO-1","DEMO-2"] |
| `query` | string | no | Apply to all issues matching this search query instead (at most 100) |
| `silent` | boolean | no | Don't send notifications about the change. Default false. |

#### `get_issue_activities`

*Get issue activities* · read-only

Returns the change history of an issue: who changed which field, comments, links, tags, attachments, sprints and work items, with old and new values. Newest first by default; paginated with a cursor.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |
| `categories` | null or array of string: `attachments`, `comments`, `created`, `description`, `fields`, `links`, `project`, `resolved`, `sprints`, `summary`, `tags`, `vcs`, `work` | no | Kinds of changes to include. Default: all. |
| `cursor` | string | no | nextCursor from a previous call, to continue |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max activities to return. Default 20, max 50. |
| `oldestFirst` | boolean | no | Return the oldest changes first. Default: newest first. |

#### `link_issues`

*Link issues* · changes data, idempotent

Links two issues. {"targetIssueId":"DEMO-1","linkType":"subtask of","issueToLinkId":"DEMO-2"} makes DEMO-1 a subtask of DEMO-2. Returns the number of linked issues per link type of the target.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issueToLinkId` | string | yes | Issue to link to, e.g. DEMO-2 |
| `linkType` | string | yes | Link name as read from the target issue, e.g. relates to, subtask of, parent for, depends on, is required for, duplicates, is duplicated by |
| `targetIssueId` | string | yes | Issue that gets the link, e.g. DEMO-1 |

#### `unlink_issues`

*Unlink issues* · destructive, idempotent

Removes a link between two issues; arguments mirror link_issues. {"targetIssueId":"DEMO-1","linkType":"subtask of","issueToLinkId":"DEMO-2"} makes DEMO-1 no longer a subtask of DEMO-2.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issueToLinkId` | string | yes | Issue to link to, e.g. DEMO-2 |
| `linkType` | string | yes | Link name as read from the target issue, e.g. relates to, subtask of, parent for, depends on, is required for, duplicates, is duplicated by |
| `targetIssueId` | string | yes | Issue that gets the link, e.g. DEMO-1 |

#### `get_issue_vcs_changes`

*Get issue VCS changes* · read-only

Returns commits and pull requests linked to an issue through a VCS integration (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea, TeamCity): version, message, author, date and links. Empty when the project has no VCS integration.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max changes to return. Default 20, max 50. |

### Comments on issues

#### `get_issue_comments`

*Get issue comments* · read-only

Returns comments of an issue, oldest first. Paginated.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |
| `includeDeleted` | boolean | no | Also list deleted comments (marked deleted, without text), e.g. to restore one. Default false. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max comments to return. Default 10, max 10. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of comments to skip. Default 0. |

#### `add_issue_comment`

*Add issue comment* · changes data

Adds a comment to an issue, optionally visible only to given users and groups. Markdown is supported. Returns the comment ID and URL.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |
| `text` | string | yes | Comment text, Markdown supported |
| `permittedGroups` | null or array of string | no | Limit visibility to these group names |
| `permittedUsers` | null or array of string | no | Limit visibility to these user logins |

#### `update_issue_comment`

*Update issue comment* · changes data, idempotent

Replaces the text of an issue comment. Markdown is supported.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `commentId` | string | yes | Comment ID from get_issue_comments, e.g. 4-17 |
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |
| `text` | string | yes | New comment text, Markdown supported |

#### `restore_issue_comment`

*Restore issue comment* · changes data, idempotent

Restores a comment that was deleted (not permanently) with delete_issue_comment or in the UI.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `commentId` | string | yes | ID of a deleted comment, from get_issue_comments with includeDeleted |
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |

#### `delete_issue_comment`

*Delete issue comment* · destructive, idempotent

Deletes a comment from an issue. By default it is marked deleted, as in the UI, and can be restored there; permanent erases it. Comment IDs come from get_issue_comments.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `commentId` | string | yes | Comment ID as returned by get_issue_comments, e.g. 4-17 |
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |
| `permanent` | boolean | no | Erase the comment for good instead of marking it deleted (needs the Delete Comment permission). Default false. |

### Files on issues and articles

#### `get_issue_attachments`

*Get attachments* · read-only

Lists the attachments of an issue or a knowledge base article: ID, file name, size, type, author and date.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `articleId` | string | no | Knowledge base article ID, e.g. DEMO-A-4 (instead of issueId) |
| `issueId` | string | no | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 (or pass articleId) |

#### `get_attachment`

*Get attachment* · read-only

Reads an attachment of an issue or article. Text files are returned as text and images as images; other files, or anything too large to inline, are saved to saveTo on this machine.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attachment` | string | yes | Attachment ID (e.g. 12-169) or file name |
| `articleId` | string | no | Knowledge base article ID, e.g. DEMO-A-4 (instead of issueId) |
| `issueId` | string | no | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 (or pass articleId) |
| `saveTo` | string | no | Local file or directory to save the attachment to instead of returning it |

#### `add_attachment`

*Add attachment* · changes data

Attaches local files (filePath, or several with filePaths), or the given text as a file, to an issue or a knowledge base article. Article text can then reference the images by file name. Returns the attachment IDs.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `articleId` | string | no | Knowledge base article ID, e.g. DEMO-A-4 (instead of issueId) |
| `fileName` | string | no | Name for a single attachment; required with textContent, defaults to the file's name |
| `filePath` | string | no | Local file to attach |
| `filePaths` | null or array of string | no | Several local files to attach in one request, e.g. all images of an article |
| `issueId` | string | no | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 (or pass articleId) |
| `textContent` | string | no | Attach this text instead of a local file, e.g. a log excerpt |

#### `delete_attachment`

*Delete attachment* · destructive, idempotent

Permanently deletes an attachment from an issue or article.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attachment` | string | yes | Attachment ID (e.g. 12-169) or file name |
| `articleId` | string | no | Knowledge base article ID, e.g. DEMO-A-4 (instead of issueId) |
| `issueId` | string | no | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 (or pass articleId) |

### Knowledge base articles

#### `search_articles`

*Search articles* · read-only

Searches the knowledge base. Returns ID, title, URL, parent article and lines matching the free-text terms. Paginated.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Knowledge base query, e.g. project: HELP, author: me, tag: faq, created: {This month}, "exact phrase", free text |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max articles to return. Default 10, max 20. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of articles to skip. Default 0. |

#### `get_article`

*Get article* · read-only

Returns an article: title, content, parent and sub-articles, tags, attachments and visibility. Long content can be read in segments with linesOffset and linesCount.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `articleId` | string | yes | Article ID, e.g. HELP-A-1 |
| `linesCount` | integer | no | Number of content lines to return. Default 500. |
| `linesOffset` | integer | no | First content line to return, 0-based. Default 0. |

#### `create_article`

*Create article* · changes data

Creates a knowledge base article, optionally under a parent article and with limited visibility. Returns the article ID and URL.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | yes | Project key, e.g. HELP |
| `summary` | string | yes | Article title |
| `content` | string | no | Article content in Markdown |
| `parentArticle` | string | no | ID of the parent article, e.g. HELP-A-1 |
| `permittedGroups` | null or array of string | no | Limit visibility to these group names |
| `permittedUsers` | null or array of string | no | Limit visibility to these user logins |

#### `update_article`

*Update article* · changes data

Changes the title, content or parent of an article. With append, content is added to the end. To change part of the content, use edit_article_content instead of resending it. Returns the article ID and URL.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `articleId` | string | yes | Article ID, e.g. HELP-A-1 |
| `append` | boolean | no | Append content to the end instead of replacing it. Default false. |
| `content` | null or string | no | New content in Markdown, or text to append when append is true |
| `parentArticleId` | null or string | no | Move the article under this parent; empty string makes it top-level |
| `summary` | null or string | no | New title |

#### `edit_article_content`

*Edit article content* · changes data

Changes part of an article's content by exact find-and-replace, without resending the whole text. Read the article first and copy oldText from it, or set regexp to match a pattern. All edits apply or none do. Returns the article ID, URL and number of replacements.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `articleId` | string | yes | Article ID, e.g. HELP-A-1 |
| `edits` | null or array of object | yes | Replacements applied in order, each to the result of the previous one |

#### `delete_article`

*Delete article* · destructive, idempotent

Permanently deletes a knowledge base article. If it has sub-articles, delete or move them first (get_article lists them).

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `articleId` | string | yes | Article ID, e.g. HELP-A-1 |

### Time tracking and reports

#### `log_work`

*Log work* · changes data

Adds a spent time work item to an issue. Use get_project to see the project's work types and work item attributes. Returns the created work item.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `durationMinutes` | integer | yes | Spent time in minutes, greater than 0 |
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |
| `date` | string | no | When the work was done: yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss in local time. Default: now. |
| `description` | string | no | What was done |
| `workItemAttributes` | object | no | Work item attributes as {attribute name: value name}; see timeTrackingSettings in get_project |
| `workType` | string | no | Work type name, e.g. Development; see workTypes in get_project |

#### `get_issue_work_items`

*Get issue work items* · read-only

Returns spent time work items of an issue, oldest first, with total minutes. Paginated.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max work items to return. Default 20, max 50. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of work items to skip. Default 0. |

#### `delete_work_item`

*Delete work item* · destructive, idempotent

Permanently deletes a spent time work item. Work item IDs come from get_issue_work_items.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |
| `workItemId` | string | yes | Work item ID from get_issue_work_items or log_work, e.g. 199-6 |

#### `get_time_report`

*Get time report* · read-only

Summarizes spent time across issues: total and per author, issue, work type, day or project, filtered by issue query, author and period. E.g. what did I log this week, or time spent on a project in a month.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `author` | string | no | Login of whoever logged the time, or me |
| `from` | string | no | First day, yyyy-MM-dd |
| `groupBy` | string: `author`, `issue`, `workType`, `day`, `project` | no | Group totals by author, issue, workType, day or project. Default author. |
| `includeItems` | boolean | no | Also list the work items (up to itemsLimit). Default false. |
| `itemsLimit` | integer | no | Max work items to list with includeItems. Default 50, max 200. |
| `query` | string | no | Issue search query limiting the issues, e.g. project: DEMO |
| `to` | string | no | Last day, yyyy-MM-dd |

### Agile boards and sprints

#### `find_agile_boards`

*Find agile boards* · read-only

Finds agile boards whose name or project key contains a substring (case-insensitive). Returns ID, name, projects, whether sprints are used and the current sprint.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nameContains` | string | yes | Case-insensitive substring of the board name or project key; empty string lists all boards |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max boards to return. Default 20, max 20. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of boards to skip. Default 0. |

#### `get_agile_board`

*Get agile board* · read-only

Returns an agile board: projects, owner, columns and the field they map to, estimation field, sprint settings, the current sprint and recent sprints.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board` | string | yes | Agile board name or ID, e.g. 195-13 |
| `includeArchived` | boolean | no | Also list archived sprints. Default false. |
| `sprintsLimit` | integer | no | Max sprints to list, newest first. Default 20. |

#### `get_sprint`

*Get sprint* · read-only

Returns a sprint of an agile board (the current one by default): name, goal, dates, archived flag and its issues with board-relevant custom fields. Paginated over issues.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board` | string | yes | Agile board name or ID, e.g. 195-13 |
| `customFieldsToReturn` | null or array of string | no | Custom fields to include per issue. Default: the board's column field, Assignee and the estimation field. Pass [] for none. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max issues to return. Default 20, max 50. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of issues to skip. Default 0. |
| `sprint` | string | no | Sprint name or ID, or current. Default: current. |

#### `create_sprint`

*Create sprint* · changes data

Creates a sprint on an agile board that uses sprints. Returns the sprint with its ID and URL.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board` | string | yes | Agile board name or ID, e.g. 195-13 |
| `name` | string | yes | Sprint name, e.g. 22.10.2026-04.11.2026 |
| `finish` | string | no | Last day, yyyy-MM-dd |
| `goal` | string | no | Sprint goal |
| `start` | string | no | First day, yyyy-MM-dd |

#### `update_sprint`

*Update sprint* · changes data, idempotent

Changes a sprint's name, goal or dates, or archives and restores it. Only the given properties change.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board` | string | yes | Agile board name or ID, e.g. 195-13 |
| `sprint` | string | yes | Sprint name or ID, or current |
| `archived` | null or boolean | no | Archive (true) or restore (false) the sprint |
| `finish` | null or string | no | New last day, yyyy-MM-dd |
| `goal` | null or string | no | New goal |
| `name` | null or string | no | New name |
| `start` | null or string | no | New first day, yyyy-MM-dd |

#### `add_issue_to_sprint`

*Add issue to sprint* · changes data, idempotent

Adds an issue to a sprint (the current one by default) of an agile board.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board` | string | yes | Agile board name or ID, e.g. 195-13 |
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |
| `sprint` | string | no | Sprint name or ID, or current. Default: current. |

#### `remove_issue_from_sprint`

*Remove issue from sprint* · changes data, idempotent

Removes an issue from a sprint (the current one by default) of an agile board. The issue itself is kept.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board` | string | yes | Agile board name or ID, e.g. 195-13 |
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |
| `sprint` | string | no | Sprint name or ID, or current. Default: current. |

#### `delete_sprint`

*Delete sprint* · destructive, idempotent

Permanently deletes a sprint from an agile board. Its issues are kept but leave the sprint. To keep history, archive it with update_sprint instead.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board` | string | yes | Agile board name or ID, e.g. 195-13 |
| `sprint` | string | yes | Sprint name or ID |

### Projects

#### `find_projects`

*Find projects* · read-only

Finds projects whose name or key contains a substring (case-insensitive). Returns key, name and ID. Paginated.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nameContains` | string | yes | Case-insensitive substring of the project name or key; empty string lists all projects |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max projects to return. Default 20, max 20. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of projects to skip. Default 0. |

#### `get_project`

*Get project* · read-only

Returns project details: key, name, description, leader, custom field names and time tracking settings including work types and work item attributes (for log_work).

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `projectKey` | string | yes | Project key, e.g. DEMO |

### Users and groups

#### `get_current_user`

*Get current user* · read-only

Returns login, email, full name and time zone of the current user.

No input.

#### `find_user`

*Find user* · read-only

Finds a user by login or email. Returns login, full name, email and time zone.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `loginOrEmail` | string | yes | Login or email of the user; "me" returns the current user |

#### `find_user_groups`

*Find user groups* · read-only

Finds user groups and project teams whose name contains a substring (case-insensitive). Paginated.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nameContains` | string | yes | Case-insensitive substring of the group name; empty string lists all groups |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max groups to return. Default 20, max 20. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of groups to skip. Default 0. |

#### `get_user_group_members`

*Get user group members* · read-only

Returns members of a user group or project team: login, full name and email. Paginated.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | string | yes | Group or project team name, as returned by find_user_groups |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max members to return. Default 20, max 20. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of members to skip. Default 0. |

### Tags

#### `manage_issue_tags`

*Manage issue tags* · changes data, idempotent

Adds a tag to an issue or removes it. The tag is given by ID or name; when no tag matches, the error lists similar tags. Returns the issue ID and its tags after the change.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issueId` | string | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |
| `operation` | string: `add`, `remove` | yes | add or remove |
| `tag` | string | yes | Tag ID (preferred, e.g. 6-12) or tag name; a name matches the first tag with that name |

#### `find_tags`

*Find tags* · read-only

Finds tags visible to the current user by name substring. Returns ID, name and owner.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nameContains` | string | yes | Case-insensitive substring of the tag name; empty string lists all visible tags |

#### `create_tag`

*Create tag* · changes data

Creates a tag owned by the current user. Use manage_issue_tags to put it on issues.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Tag name |

#### `update_tag`

*Update tag* · changes data, idempotent

Renames a tag.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | New tag name |
| `tag` | string | yes | Tag ID or name; among equal names your own tag wins |

#### `delete_tag`

*Delete tag* · destructive, idempotent

Permanently deletes a tag and removes it from all issues.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | string | yes | Tag ID or name; among equal names your own tag wins |

### Saved searches

#### `get_saved_issue_searches`

*Get saved issue searches* · read-only

Returns the current user's favorite saved issue searches. Their queries can be passed to search_issues.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Max searches to return. Default 20, max 20. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of searches to skip. Default 0. |

#### `create_saved_search`

*Create saved search* · changes data

Saves a search query under a name. It is not added to favorites; pin it in the UI to see it in get_saved_issue_searches.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Saved search name |
| `query` | string | yes | YouTrack search query |

#### `update_saved_search`

*Update saved search* · changes data, idempotent

Renames a saved search or changes its query.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `search` | string | yes | Saved search ID or name; among equal names your own search wins |
| `name` | null or string | no | New name |
| `query` | null or string | no | New query |

#### `delete_saved_search`

*Delete saved search* · destructive, idempotent

Permanently deletes a saved search.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `search` | string | yes | Saved search ID or name; among equal names your own search wins |

### Raw REST calls (call_api)

#### `call_api`

*Call YouTrack REST API* · destructive

Calls any YouTrack (or Hub) REST endpoint as the current user, for what no other tool covers. YouTrack returns only entity IDs unless you pass a fields query, e.g. fields=idReadable,summary,customFields(name,value(name)). Prefer GET; POST and DELETE change data. Reference: https://www.jetbrains.com/help/youtrack/devportal/api-entities.html

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | string: `GET`, `POST`, `DELETE` | yes | HTTP method |
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to the API root, e.g. issues/DEMO-1/comments or admin/projects; a query string may be included |
| `api` | string: `youtrack`, `hub` | no | youtrack (/api/…, default) or hub (/hub/api/rest/…) |
| `body` | any | no | JSON request body for POST |
| `query` | object | no | Query parameters, e.g. {"fields":"idReadable,summary","$top":10}; arrays repeat the parameter |

### Prompts

#### `issue_brief`

Catch up on an issue: what it is about, where it stands, what was decided and what's open.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `issue` | yes | Issue ID, e.g. DEMO-123 |

#### `sprint_report`

Status of a sprint on an agile board: done and open work, who has what, scope changes, time and risks.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `board` | yes | Agile board name or ID |
| `sprint` | no | Sprint name or ID. Default: the current one. |

#### `standup`

My stand-up from YouTrack: what I did since the last working day, what's next, what blocks me.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `days` | no | Working days to look back. Default 1, so Friday on a Monday. |

#### `triage`

Go through untriaged issues of a project and propose type, priority, assignee and duplicates; applies only what I approve.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | yes | Project short name, e.g. DEMO |
| `query` | no | Which issues to triage. Default: unresolved and unassigned, newest first. |

## Pipeline tools

A pipeline gives its agent the MCP tools above, under the name `ymcp`, and these three, which talk to the
pipeline running it.

#### `report`

*Report status* · changes data

Posts a brief interim status of your work to the issue. Use it rarely, for progress worth telling mid-turn; your final message is published for you, so don't repeat it here.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | A brief status update, Markdown supported |

#### `request_input`

*Request input* · changes data

Asks a human for a decision you can't make yourself, e.g. when the issue is ambiguous or contradicts the code. Say what you need, the options and your recommendation. The question is posted for you and returns at once: end your turn right after the call; the reply arrives as your next message.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `question` | string | yes | What you need decided: the question, the options and your recommendation. Markdown is supported. |

#### `set_change`

*Set the PR/MR* · changes data

Sets the title and description of the pull or merge request of your branch. ymcp opens it with them after pushing, or updates it. Call it when ymcp asks for them; the latest call wins.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | yes | Its description, Markdown supported |
| `title` | string | yes | The title of the pull or merge request, one line |

## Pipeline file

A pipeline is a JSON file in `<config dir>/ymcp/pipelines/<name>.json`, written by the wizard or by hand
(see [Pipelines](../README.md#pipelines)). These are its fields; durations are strings such as `"90s"`,
`"10m"` or `"2h"`, and templates take `{{issue.id}}`-style keys.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | The pipeline's name, also its file's |
| `profile` | string | The ymcp profile of the YouTrack instance |
| `source` | object | Where issues come from |
| `source.query` | string | The YouTrack search of the issues to take |
| `source.pollInterval` | duration | How often YouTrack, the code host and the CI are read, default 60s |
| `stages` | object | The YouTrack commands and searches of each stage |
| `stages.<working\|review\|needsInput\|done\|closed>.enter` | string | The YouTrack command that moves an issue into the stage |
| `stages.<working\|review\|needsInput\|done\|closed>.match` | string | The YouTrack search that finds issues in the stage |
| `stages.<working\|review\|needsInput\|done\|closed>.exit` | string | The command that leaves it (needsInput) |
| `stages.<working\|review\|needsInput\|done\|closed>.enabled` | boolean | Whether the stage is used: on unless false, except done, which is off unless true. |
| `workspace` | object | Where and on which branch the agent works |
| `workspace.host` | string | An ssh host alias, or empty for this machine |
| `workspace.dir` | string | The git repository on the host |
| `workspace.base` | string | The branch to start from; empty for origin's default branch |
| `workspace.branch` | string | Template of a run's branch, default "{{issue.id}}-{{issue.summary \| slug}}" |
| `workspace.commitPrefix` | string | Template put in front of the agent's commit messages, default "{{issue.id}}"; "" for none |
| `workspace.worktrees` | string | Where the runs' worktrees go, ~ being the home directory on the host; empty for <user cache dir>/ymcp/worktrees/<pipeline> on the host |
| `workspace.parallel` | number | How many issues are worked on at once, default 1 |
| `workspace.keepWorktree` | boolean | Keep a run's worktree after it ends |
| `workspace.identity` | object | A git author of the agent's own in each worktree. Off by default: the agent commits as the repository's user.name and user.email. |
| `workspace.identity.enabled` | boolean | Commit as the agent's own author; off by default |
| `workspace.identity.name` | string | Template of the author's name, default "{{agent.name}} · {{pipeline.name}} #{{run.number}}" |
| `workspace.identity.tag` | string | Template of what goes after "+" in the address, default "agent_{{pipeline.name}}_{{run.number}}" |
| `agent` | object | The coding agent |
| `agent.provider` | string | One of claude, kimi, opencode, acp, anthropic or openai |
| `agent.name` | string | The agent's name in messages; default from the provider |
| `agent.command` | string | The executable or its full path; required for acp |
| `agent.model` | string | The model, as the agent names it; required for anthropic and openai unless the preset has one |
| `agent.mode` | string | The agent's mode, e.g. a claude permission mode |
| `agent.args` | array of string | More command-line arguments of the agent |
| `agent.env` | object of string | Environment variables of the agent |
| `agent.endpoint` | object | The model API of the anthropic and openai providers |
| `agent.endpoint.preset` | string | A known service: openrouter, kimi-coding, zai, deepseek, minimax or ollama |
| `agent.endpoint.url` | string | The API's base URL; default from the preset |
| `agent.endpoint.keyEnv` | string | The variable with the API key, read before the keychain; default from the preset |
| `permissions` | string | Tool calls the agent wasn't allowed: ask (default), allow or deny |
| `timeouts` | object | Limits of a run |
| `timeouts.silence` | duration | An agent silent this long is stuck, default 10m |
| `timeouts.total` | duration | The longest one turn of the agent may take, default 2h |
| `timeouts.permission` | duration | How long a permission request waits for a person, default 30m |
| `strategy` | object | How finished work is published |
| `strategy.kind` | string | One of branch (default), github-pr, github-issue-pr or gitlab-mr |
| `strategy.draft` | boolean | Open pull and merge requests as drafts |
| `strategy.squash` | boolean | Tick a GitLab merge request's "Squash commits" and "Delete source branch" options. |
| `strategy.deleteBranch` | boolean | See squash |
| `strategy.describe` | boolean | Asks the agent for the PR/MR's title and description in a turn of their own after each push (prompts.describe), and updates the PR/MR with them unless a person edited it. On unless false. |
| `strategy.title` | string | Template of the PR/MR title, default "{{issue.key}} {{issue.summary}}"; {{commit.subject}} is the subject of the branch's first commit. |
| `feedback` | object | Whose replies the agent reacts to |
| `feedback.debounce` | duration | How long to wait for more replies before a turn, default 60s |
| `feedback.youtrack` | array of string | Logins besides yours whose comments are feedback |
| `feedback.github` | array of string | Logins besides yours |
| `feedback.gitlab` | array of string | Usernames besides yours |
| `language` | string | The language of everything the agent writes in public, default "English" |
| `prompts` | object | The prompt templates |
| `prompts.preset` | string | The preset an empty prompt comes from, default "fix" |
| `prompts.start` | string | Template of a run's first turn |
| `prompts.feedback` | string | Template of a turn on replies |
| `prompts.answer` | string | Template of a turn that answers the agent's question |
| `prompts.describe` | string | Template of the turn that asks for the PR/MR's title and description after a push; {{change.noun}} is "pull request" or "merge request". |
| `messages` | object of string | Replacements of ymcp's own texts, by key |
| `service` | boolean | Send ymcp's service instruction to the agent; on unless false |
| `autoCompact` | boolean | Compacts a run's comments when it ends as done or closed, as a /compact reply does: they are hidden and a short summary is left. |
| `notifications` | object | Narrows the machine's notification settings for this pipeline; unset keeps them as they are. |
| `notifications.providers` | array of string | The providers to use, e.g. ["toast"]; empty for all enabled |
| `notifications.events` | array of string | The events to tell, e.g. ["needs_input", "run_failed"]; empty for each provider's own |
| `ci` | object | How the runner watches the CI of what the agent pushes. |
| `ci.watch` | boolean | Watch the CI of each push; on unless false |
| `ci.fixes` | number | Turns in a row the agent gets for a failing CI, default 3 |
